user.title: Eteck Tariffs
user.description:
Choose the Eteck project your home is connected to.

**Is your project not in the list?** Tariffs are added by the community from the yearly tariff sheet ("Product- en tarievenblad") Eteck publishes for your project. Close this window, then either [request your project]({issue_url}) by uploading that PDF, or [add it yourself]({contributing_url}). Your project appears here after the next update of the integration.

data_description.project: The name is printed at the top of your tariff sheet.

outdated_tariffs.title: Eteck tariffs for {year} are missing
outdated_tariffs.description: There are no {year} tariffs yet for {project}, so the tariffs of {used_year} are used. Update the integration, or add the new tariffs with a pull request.
